newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Multivision plans IPO during Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Multivision plans IPO during Q1 1997.

text.p: Mexican pay TV operator Grupo Multivision S.A. said on Monday it plans to go public during the first quarter of next year.
"We plan a public offering during the first three months of next year," Ernesto Vargas, the president of Multivision, told reporters during a news conference in Mexico City.

Vargas said the company, which operates both wireless cable TV and satellite TV operations, is close to choosing the lead manager of the deal and will likely offer stock in Mexican and international equity markets.
Vargas would not discuss the amount of money involved in the deal, but he said the money would be used to expand the company's operations.
Multivision had planned an IPO during the first months of 1995, but shelved the plans after Mexico's peso devaluation of December, 1994, threw the economy into crisis.
Multivision is Mexico's leading pay TV company and is also in a joint venture with Hughes Electronics Corp. in offering direct-to-home satellite TV in Mexico.
